title: Stoneridge Investment Partners LLC Sells 16,569 Shares of Apple Inc. (AAPL)
text:
Tweet
Stoneridge Investment Partners LLC reduced its stake in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 12.2% in the second quarter, according to the company in its most recent 13F filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). The institutional investor owned 119,030 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 16,569 shares during the quarter. Apple comprises approximately 4.2% of Stoneridge Investment Partners LLC’s holdings, making the stock its 2nd largest position. Stoneridge Investment Partners LLC’s holdings in Apple were worth $22,034,000 as of its most recent SEC filing.
Other institutional investors and hedge funds also recently made changes to their positions in the company. Bfsg LLC boosted its position in shares of Apple by 4.0% during the 2nd quarter. Bfsg LLC now owns 32,381 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $5,994,000 after acquiring an additional 1,254 shares during the last quarter. Commonwealth Equity Services LLC boosted its position in shares of Apple by 0.5% during the 2nd quarter. Commonwealth Equity Services LLC now owns 2,753,434 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $509,688,000 after acquiring an additional 13,215 shares during the last quarter. First Bank & Trust boosted its position in shares of Apple by 5.0% during the 2nd quarter. First Bank & Trust now owns 5,772 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $1,069,000 after acquiring an additional 275 shares during the last quarter. Accredited Investors Inc. boosted its position in shares of Apple by 28.9% during the 2nd quarter. Accredited Investors Inc. now owns 48,550 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $8,987,000 after acquiring an additional 10,895 shares during the last quarter. Finally, Allianz Life Insurance Co. of North America lifted its position in Apple by 26.6% in the second quarter. Allianz Life Insurance Co. of North America now owns 3,983 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $737,000 after buying an additional 838 shares during the last quarter. 57.65% of the stock is owned by institutional investors and hedge funds. In other Apple news, insider Luca Maestri sold 100,245 shares of Apple stock in a transaction dated Thursday, October 4th. The stock was sold at an average price of $228.56, for a total value of $22,911,997.20. Following the transaction, the insider now owns 91,665 shares in the company, valued at $20,950,952.40. The transaction was disclosed in a legal filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which is available through the SEC website . Also, CEO Timothy D. Cook sold 265,160 shares of Apple stock in a transaction dated Monday, August 27th. The shares were sold at an average price of $217.79, for a total value of $57,749,196.40. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . In the last 90 days, insiders have sold 470,005 shares of company stock worth $104,764,873. Insiders own 0.08% of the company’s stock. Shares of Apple stock opened at $176.78 on Thursday. The firm has a market cap of $869.88 billion, a PE ratio of 14.84, a PEG ratio of 1.27 and a beta of 1.26. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.87, a quick ratio of 1.09 and a current ratio of 1.12. Apple Inc. has a 12 month low of $150.24 and a 12 month high of $233.47.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last announced its quarterly earnings results on Thursday, November 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.91 EPS for the quarter, beating the consensus estimate of $2.78 by $0.13. The firm had revenue of $62.90 billion for the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $61.55 billion. Apple had a return on equity of 48.68% and a net margin of 22.41%. The business’s revenue for the quarter was up 19.6% on a year-over-year basis. During the same quarter last year, the firm posted $2.07 earnings per share. Sell-side analysts predict that Apple Inc. will post 13.35 earnings per share for the current year.
The company also recently declared a quarterly dividend, which was paid on Thursday, November 15th. Stockholders of record on Monday, November 12th were paid a dividend of $0.73 per share. The ex-dividend date of this dividend was Thursday, November 8th. This represents a $2.92 annualized dividend and a dividend yield of 1.65%. Apple’s dividend payout ratio is currently 24.52%.
A number of analysts recently issued reports on AAPL shares. UBS Group started coverage on Apple in a research report on Wednesday, September 12th. Maxim Group raised their price target on Apple to $221.00 and gave the stock an “average” rating in a research report on Thursday, September 13th. Royal Bank of Canada raised their price target on Apple to $250.00 and gave the stock an “average” rating in a research report on Wednesday, September 26th. Guggenheim restated a “buy” rating and issued a $235.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research report on Wednesday, August 1st. Finally, BTIG Research upgraded Apple to a “buy” rating and lifted their target price for the stock from $207.00 to $235.00 in a research report on Wednesday, August 1st. Three analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, twenty-three have assigned a hold rating and twenty-five have given a buy rating to the stock. Apple has an average rating of “Hold” and a consensus target price of $223.07.
About Apple
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers. It also sells various related software, services, accessories, and third-party digital content and applications. The company offers iPhone, a line of smartphones; iPad, a line of multi-purpose tablets; and Mac, a line of desktop and portable personal computers, as well as iOS, macOS, watchOS, and tvOS operating systems.
